{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the number of -1 values in customer_age
num_negative_one = (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {num_negative_one}")

# Drop rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data)
sales_clean = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = sales_clean['customer_age'].mean()
print(f"Mean age of customers (excluding -1 values): {mean_age}")

# Also print the number of valid rows
n_valid = len(sales_clean)
print(f"Number of valid age entries: {n_valid}")"}
